import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_85/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_85/test_1.csv"

# Load Source 0
# Schema: ['calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name', 'calaccess_filing_id', 'date_received',
#          'contributor_lastname', 'contributor_firstname', 'contributor_city', 'contributor_state',
#          'contributor_zip', 'contributor_employer', 'contributor_occupation',
#          'contributor_is_self_employed', 'amount']
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, dtype={
    'calaccess_committee_id': 'Int64',
    'committee_name': 'string',
    'calaccess_filing_id': 'Int64',
    'date_received': 'string',
    'contributor_lastname': 'string',
    'contributor_firstname': 'string',
    'contributor_city': 'string',
    'contributor_state': 'string',
    'contributor_zip': 'string',
    'contributor_employer': 'string',
    'contributor_occupation': 'string',
    'contributor_is_self_employed': 'boolean',
    'amount': 'float'
})

# Load Source 1
# Schema: ['ocd_prop_id', 'calaccess_prop_id', 'ccdc_prop_id', 'prop_name',
#          'ccdc_committee_id', 'calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name', 'committee_position']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, dtype={
    'ocd_prop_id': 'string',
    'calaccess_prop_id': 'Int64',
    'ccdc_prop_id': 'Int64',
    'prop_name': 'string',
    'ccdc_committee_id': 'Int64',
    'calaccess_committee_id': 'Int64',
    'committee_name': 'string',
    'committee_position': 'string'
})

# Rename committee_name in df1 to committee_name_x to match target schema
df1 = df1.rename(columns={'committee_name': 'committee_name_x'})

# We need to join df0 and df1 to produce the target table.
# The target schema requires:
# ['ocd_prop_id': string,
#  'calaccess_prop_id': integer,
#  'ccdc_prop_id': integer,
#  'prop_name': string,
#  'ccdc_committee_id': integer,
#  'calaccess_committee_id': integer,
#  'committee_name_x': string,
#  'committee_position': string,
#  'committee_name_y': string,
#  'calaccess_filing_id': integer,
#  'date_received': string,
#  'contributor_lastname': string,
#  'contributor_firstname': string,
#  'contributor_city': string,
#  'contributor_state': string,
#  'contributor_zip': string,
#  'contributor_employer': string,
#  'contributor_occupation': string,
#  'contributor_is_self_employed': boolean,
#  'amount': float]

# committee_name_y comes from df0's committee_name column
# df0 has committee_name, df1 has committee_name_x

# Join keys:
# Both have calaccess_committee_id, so join on that.
# df1 has calaccess_committee_id and committee_position, df0 has calaccess_committee_id and committee_name (to become committee_name_y)

# We also want to bring in the prop info from df1 to df0's contributor-level data.

# Perform a left join of df0 with df1 on calaccess_committee_id to bring in proposition and committee info.
# Because df0 has many contributors per committee, and df1 has committee info, this join will replicate committee info for each contributor.

df_merged = pd.merge(
    df0,
    df1,
    how='left',
    on='calaccess_committee_id',
    suffixes=('_y', '_x')  # to avoid confusion, but we already renamed committee_name in df1 to committee_name_x
)

# After merge, columns from df1 are:
# ocd_prop_id, calaccess_prop_id, ccdc_prop_id, prop_name, ccdc_committee_id,
# calaccess_committee_id, committee_name_x, committee_position

# Columns from df0 are:
# calaccess_committee_id, committee_name (will be committee_name_y), calaccess_filing_id, date_received,
# contributor_lastname, contributor_firstname, contributor_city, contributor_state, contributor_zip,
# contributor_employer, contributor_occupation, contributor_is_self_employed, amount

# Rename df0's committee_name to committee_name_y to match target schema
df_merged = df_merged.rename(columns={'committee_name': 'committee_name_y'})

# Select and reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'ocd_prop_id',               # from df1
    'calaccess_prop_id',         # from df1
    'ccdc_prop_id',              # from df1
    'prop_name',                 # from df1
    'ccdc_committee_id',         # from df1
    'calaccess_committee_id',    # from both
    'committee_name_x',          # from df1
    'committee_position',        # from df1
    'committee_name_y',          # from df0
    'calaccess_filing_id',       # from df0
    'date_received',             # from df0
    'contributor_lastname',      # from df0
    'contributor_firstname',     # from df0
    'contributor_city',          # from df0
    'contributor_state',         # from df0
    'contributor_zip',           # from df0
    'contributor_employer',      # from df0
    'contributor_occupation',    # from df0
    'contributor_is_self_employed', # from df0
    'amount'                    # from df0
]

# Some columns might have missing values due to the join; fill or keep as is.

# Ensure all target columns exist in df_merged
missing_cols = [col for col in target_columns if col not in df_merged.columns]
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing columns after merge: {missing_cols}")

df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

# Enforce data types according to target schema
df_target = df_target.astype({
    'ocd_prop_id': 'string',
    'calaccess_prop_id': 'Int64',
    'ccdc_prop_id': 'Int64',
    'prop_name': 'string',
    'ccdc_committee_id': 'Int64',
    'calaccess_committee_id': 'Int64',
    'committee_name_x': 'string',
    'committee_position': 'string',
    'committee_name_y': 'string',
    'calaccess_filing_id': 'Int64',
    'date_received': 'string',
    'contributor_lastname': 'string',
    'contributor_firstname': 'string',
    'contributor_city': 'string',
    'contributor_state': 'string',
    'contributor_zip': 'string',
    'contributor_employer': 'string',
    'contributor_occupation': 'string',
    'contributor_is_self_employed': 'boolean',
    'amount': 'float'
})

# Write the result to the target CSV file
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_85/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
